subject: Omega Analytics - competitive bake-off plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya@omegaanalytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-03T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Omega Analytics - competitive bake-off plan

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal: compare Redwood inference against Bedrock and Vertex AI for your customer-facing summarization feature (50–500 tokens outputs, low-latency SLA).
- Success criteria (initial): p95 latency < 300ms for 100 concurrent users, average cost per 1k tokens < $X (TBD), and no regressions on our 10-sample fidelity set (you provided examples).
- Proposed tests: latency (cold/warm), throughput (1–200 concurrency), quality A/B using your 10 eval prompts, cost-estimates using 1M tokens/month profile.
- Timeline: kickoff this week -> run tests next week -> results/retrospective the following week.
- Owners: Marissa (engagement lead), Aditya (SE lead, test plan & scripts), Priya/Samir (data/sample + procurement for test accounts).

I've attached a bake-off template and a draft test plan to make it concrete.

Next actions:
1) Please confirm test dataset (small sample attached: omega-data-sample.csv) and provide any additional fidelity prompts.
2) Confirm which hyperscaler endpoints you want included (you mentioned Bedrock + Vertex?)
3) Agree to timeline — can we schedule a 30-min kickoff on Friday 11/07? I'll send a calendar invite after your OK.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood-bakeoff-template.xlsx

From: Priya Menon <priya@omegaanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@omegaanalytics.com>
Date: 2025-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Omega Analytics - competitive bake-off plan

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap — this looks good. A few follow-ups from our side:

- Confirm we want Bedrock (for x-latency profile) and Vertex AI for parity checks.
- For cost comparison, we'll need per-1k-token estimates; can Redwood provide sample cost guidance for quantized models?
- For the quality set, we'll add five more prompts focused on customer support dialogues.

We can do the kickoff on Friday 11/07 11:00am PT. I'll confirm with Samir and share a small procurement checklist (we may need temporary trial keys for Bedrock/Vertex).

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Menon
Head of Product, Omega Analytics
priya@omegaanalytics.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-04T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Omega Analytics - competitive bake-off plan (technical plan)

Thanks Priya/Marissa — looping in the technical plan below.

Test plan (high level):
- Benchmarks: cold start, warm cache (after 200 requests), and sustained throughput.
- Models: Redwood-XXL (quantized FP16/int8 variants), Bedrock model X, Vertex model Y.
- Metrics: p50/p90/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens (estimated), and fidelity score on your eval set.
- Test harness: will use k6 with a Redwood SDK adapter and Bedrock/Vertex clients. We'll open-source the harness snippets for repeatability.

Owners & next steps:
- Aditya: build harness + metric dashboard (ETA: 5 business days after kickoff)
- Marissa: coordinate procurement/trial access + scheduling
- Priya/Samir: provide sample data and fidelity prompts

I'll attach the draft test plan (redwood-test-plan.md) with exact commands and data formats.

- Aditya

Attachments: redwood-test-plan.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Menon <priya@omegaanalytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-11-05T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Omega Analytics - competitive bake-off plan

Perfect — thanks Aditya and Priya.

Confirming kickoff: Friday 11/07 11:00am PT (calendar invite sent).

Immediate asks for Priya/Samir before the kickoff:
- Confirm Bedrock + Vertex as the hyperscalers to include.
- Share the additional 5 fidelity prompts and final sample dataset (if >100MB, share a Drive link).
- For procurement: can you open trial access for Redwood to run tests against your Bedrock/Vertex accounts? If not possible, we can run Redwood-hosted tests and have you run the hyperscaler scripts.

Meeting agenda (30 min):
1) Introductions + scope (5 min)
2) Walkthrough of test plan and success criteria (10 min)
3) Scheduling + ownership (5 min)
4) Q&A & procurement next steps (10 min)

I'll also include success criteria in the invite notes. Looking forward — talk Friday.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Related links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3Credwood-bakeoff

Thanks — Confirming Bedrock + Vertex included. Samir is looping in procurement and will send the trial checklist.
